image_description: A close-up photograph featuring two prominent white daisies with bright yellow centers against a dark, blurred background. A third partial daisy is visible in the upper left corner. The flowers exhibit classic composite structure with radiating white ray florets and textured yellow disc florets. Green stems are faintly visible supporting the blooms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Composite flower with central yellow disc surrounded by single whorl of white ray petals.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both main subjects clearly display the composite structure with distinct yellow centers and white radial petals.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flower head is modest in size with numerous elongated white petals radiating outward.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The petals are elongated and radiate correctly from the center; count appears consistent with natural variation (approx. 13-20 visible per flower).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bright yellow center with bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The yellow centers show appropriate granular texture indicative of disc florets, not just a flat yellow circle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Petals narrow, slightly pointed, arranged in flat, circular pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Petals are narrow with rounded-to-slightly-pointed tips, arranged in a planar radial symmetry typical of daisies.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slender green stem supporting flower head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Green stems are visible beneath the flower heads, appearing slender and structurally supportive.
The depth of field blurs the lower stem area significantly; no distinct leaves are resolvable in the visible frame.
The image is a close-up crop; the ground attachment point is outside the frame or obscured by blur.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Single stem supporting composite flower head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Each visible flower head appears to be supported by its own individual stem structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central disc florets form textured yellow center.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Redundant with Flower_or_Top checkpoint but confirmed: the texture is present and realistic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and minor 'haloing' or blending into the dark background on the rightmost petals, typical of AI generation or aggressive denoising, but not structurally catastrophic.
One petal on the left flower (approx. 4 o'clock position) seems to merge slightly with the adjacent petal without a clear boundary line, suggesting minor topological ambiguity.

To assess the naturalness of the depth-of-field blur and ensure the background bokeh does not contain structural artifacts.
To verify that the stems are correctly positioned behind/under the flower heads and not floating or merging incorrectly.
